trigger: The isolated TIM module implementation proved that V12 defines the close-period aggregate but no authorized runtime producer creates tme_close_periods.

backendWip.head: fcb5c1f397d14ea77c7ff9714a272449d99e18a4
backendWip.wipPathAndContentManifestAlgorithm: From the backend worktree, emit git ls-files --modified --others --exclude-standard as NUL-delimited paths, sort paths bytewise with sort -z, run shasum -a 256 for every path in that order using the exact '<hex><two spaces><path><newline>' output, then hash that complete manifest with shasum -a 256.
backendWip.porcelainAlgorithm: From the backend worktree, hash the exact bytes emitted by git status --porcelain=v1 with shasum -a 256.

observedFacts: V12 requires legal_entity_public_id, time_group_public_id, payroll_entity_public_id, pay_period_public_id, period_start and period_end for every tme_close_periods row.
The active TIM public contract contains validate, close, reopen, payroll-handoff create and handoff query operations, but no close-period create operation.
No authorized runtime source in dwp-backend inserts tme_close_periods; current TIM WIP only reads and transitions an existing row.
A database INSERT grant is a capability boundary and does not establish business source authority.
Current period rows do not carry a source-definition identity, source revision, source digest or population-source lineage sufficient to prove materialization authority.
The actor/grant populationScopeDigest on a command receipt is not a substitute for period-source population provenance.

rejectedCandidates.reason: It has no deployed period publication workload, stable payPeriodId, timeGroup binding or population source revision and digest. BASE-TFR-PAY-007 is already complete and frozen and is not reopened by this decision.
It is the PAY platform-notification slice, not a payroll-period source owner.
It is REFERENCE data with sourceConfirmed false and cannot establish a production source authority.
The existing contract explicitly states that constructors confer no authority and a source alias is not a deployment stream.

rejectedCandidates.candidate: Derivation from V11 timecards or IAQ
rejectedCandidates.reason: V11 lacks authoritative legal-entity, time-group, payroll-entity, pay-period and source-provenance facts required by V12.

monthToPayrollPeriod.reason: Weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly and custom payroll cadences do not prove that one calendar month maps to exactly one pay period.

silently split one monthly close into child payroll periods
